about: Saint Bernard Abbey's own choices. bvmSaturdays: the Saturday Commemoration of the Blessed Virgin Mary (Office and Mass), on all open Saturdays through the year and once in Easter Time; the list from the Office of the Master of Ceremonies, calculated by Br. Thomas. notices: the Master of Ceremonies' notices of upcoming celebrations, by date ("Upcoming Liturgical Celebrations"), shown on the ordo line and in the calendar. namedays: each brother's name day (month-day: [name, patron]), from the abbey site's monastery page (munkachy/newmonksite, the monk cards; Nov 2026), shown under the day bar.

2026-11-01: All Saints will be an Office of the Abbot.
2026-11-02: All Souls will be an Office of the Abbot.
Cemetery procession with Vespers of the Dead will begin at 4 p.m.
Procession will begin in Statio, from the usual place.
Cucullas are to be worn for Offices and Mass.
2026-11-13: Treated like a normal feast (statio, servers, cucullas, etc.).
There are three readings (OT, NT, and Gospel).
NOT an Office of the Abbot.
2026-11-14: The Office of the Dead is prayed.
Abbot responsible for Orations in the Office.
Mass is said as on a feast (incense, servers, statio, cucullas).
There are three readings (OT, NT, and Gospel).
Vespers will be I Vespers of Sunday.
